dog.description_text:
What my friends at ACC say about me:

My history is a mystery and my friends here do not know much about me yet!

I will need daily physical activity to keep me healthy and happy!

A Volunteer Wrote: Bryan will turn any day into a joyful one if you just give her a second to sort out how she most wants to entertain you: Dropping a ball at your feet? Sitting in your lap? Dropping a ball in your lap? Showing you what a good girl she is when you ask her to sit? Throughout it all, her tail never, ever stops wagging, and every person she passes says, "Oh...." with delight at her delight. Bryan is a dream of a dog waiting for the dream of a forever home.
dog.name: Bryan
